cleo (Design): quick check on account form behavior: should we surface inline errors as the user types, or keep them hidden until submit and show a short top summary? also debating required marker: small pill labeled 'Required' vs traditional asterisk. and final thing: destructive flow for deleting a project 1 typed-confirm or simple modal? attaching mini-mock: https://drive.redwood.design/ux/account-form-compact.png noah (PM): my read: inline for format/length to help fix fast. show a compact top summary only when submit fails with multiple issues. keep copy short. :+1: rachel (A11y): inline is fine but must be announced (aria-live) and not rely on color. asterisk-only won't cut it for screen readers. use sr-only "required" or aria-required. top summary should move focus to it and include jump links. diego (Frontend): feasible: inline on blur + live region. top summary would be an alert with anchors. small example: ```html
2 problems found
``` anya (Eng): for deletes I prefer typed-confirm for project-level deletes (type project slug). it prevents accidental deletes. add server-side idempotency to avoid duplicates. for item deletes, modal + undo toast is enough. cleo (Design): proposal: show inline validation while typing for single-field rules. on submit, if >1 errors reveal a compact top summary (max 4 bullets) with anchors. required: visible asterisk + sr-only "required" text. delete: typed-confirm for projects; item deletes show modal with undo. rachel (A11y): approve. small nit: ensure error text contrast >= 4.5:1 and that summary links are keyboard-focusable. I can run a quick audit after mocks updated. noah (PM): copy tweak for delete modal: prefer: "Deleting this project is permanent. Type the project slug to confirm." direct and action-first. diego (Frontend): edge-case: if server returns field-level error after client fixes (e.g., slug taken) surface it in summary and attach to field via aria-describedby so SR users see context. ops-bot: accessibility-check: aria-live for inline updates suggested; role=alert + focus on summary; sr-only required labels recommended. cleo (Design): thanks all 1 I'll update the mock to show the inline+summary flow, add sr-only required text, and draft delete copy. pinging @rachel for audit once done. sync tomorrow 11:30am. :spiral_calendar_pad:
